events.title: Saving Begins in New Jersey
events.summary: Jorge and Marissa begin saving steadily in New Jersey while placing the lucky Golden Garbanzo chickpea inside a small copper pot on the kitchen counter.

events.title: Clara Joins the Family
events.summary: Clara is born, turning quiet saving into a joyful countdown toward shared mornings, bikes, dancing, and unhurried childhood years.

events.title: Building Garbanzo the Desk-Bot
events.summary: Jorge builds a chickpea-shaped desk-bot on his home computer to track daily savings at ten o'clock, unknowingly leaving in a Double-Counting Bug.

events.title: Saying Goodbye to Poki
events.summary: Poki passes peacefully, leaving a small silver collar bell and smooth gray stone on the kitchen windowsill.

events.title: The Cold Chickpea & Kitchen Table Deal
events.summary: Garbanzo misfires, Clara leaves a crayon warning against letting work eat Tuesdays, the parents agree on a fair 50/50 plan, and sleek costume-free Poki visits Clara in silver light.

events.title: House Hunting in Spain & Discovering Valladolid
events.summary: The family rejects empty tourist pools and overpriced crooked lots, plays a dramatic glass-wall padel game, and finds a sunny modern home near Valladolid.

events.title: Fixing Garbanzo & Saying Goodbye to Manhattan
events.summary: Jorge patches Garbanzo during a winter storm, checks cross-border tax and health rules with real advisors, turns down one last office bonus, and finds the golden sun key charm inside the pot.

events.title: Aunt Lidia's Stew & Tuesday at Ten O'Clock
events.summary: After a joyous farewell cocido madrileño dinner, the family flies to Spain and settles into calm, bright mornings together in Valladolid.
